tools.name: find_fashion_items
tools.description: Use this only when the user has supplied a photo, screenshot, direct image URL, social post, blog, or product page containing fashion to identify, visually match, or shop. A visual source is required. Pass that source directly because Remode resolves supported public links without a preliminary web

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: Use this when the user provides one specific fashion product-page URL and asks whether the same item is available elsewhere, cheaper, second-hand, or from another retailer. Remode compares the exact product first and labels merely similar alternatives separately. Do not use for a photo without a pro

tools.name: find_fashion_by_description
tools.description: Use this for concrete purchase-intent fashion requests written entirely in text: a garment, shoe, bag, jewelry, watch, or wearable accessory; a brand/model; a budget; colour; size; condition; second-hand request; dupe; or similar alternative. No photo, screenshot, product link, or other visual sourc

tools.name: watch_item
tools.description: Persistently add a specific fashion product URL to the connected user's Remode watch list for lower-price or second-hand monitoring. When the supplied product is explicitly marked in_stock=false, the same watch also detects a restock; never infer stock state. Use when the user explicitly asks to wat

tools.name: get_watch_updates
tools.description: Read the linked user's active Remode watches and verified recent updates. Use when the user asks what Remode is watching or whether anything changed.

tools.name: update_watch
tools.description: Change whether an existing Remode watch looks for lower prices, second-hand matches, or both. Requires the stable watch_id returned by Remode.

tools.name: stop_watching_item
tools.description: Stop an existing Remode watch. Use only after the user asks to stop tracking an item. Requires the stable watch_id returned by Remode.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?platform=mcp_registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_price, watch_item · Public sink: find_fashion_items.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_price, watch_item · Public sink: find_fashion_items

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
